description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover that `nexus-safe` is the correct tool with three key enforcement policies: Allowlist, Logs-First, and Rate Limiting. (2) Discover from SKILL.md that it must set the `NEXUS_SAFE_ALLOWED_PM2` environment variable to include `api-gateway` before any recovery is possible — otherwise the tool exits with a POLICY VIOLATION error. (3) Run `nexus-safe logs api-gateway` FIRST to satisfy the Logs-First Policy (logs must be reviewed within the last 5 minutes before `recover` is allowed). (4) Run `nexus-safe recover api-gateway` — which will succeed because: the service is now allowlisted, logs were reviewed recently, and the rate limit (3/hour) has not been exceeded. The tool prints a JSON summary with keys: service, action, runtime, status, timestamp. (5) Write `incident_report.json` at the workspace root, incorporating the recovery summary JSON. The eval script verifies: the file exists, the recovery summary fields are present and correct (service=api-gateway, action=restart, status=success), and that the nexus-safe state files confirm logs were reviewed before the restart (Logs-First policy).
